messages:
Lena Ortiz: FYI  AuroraAI case study timeline. Interview done, transcript + audio uploaded to Drive. Need final quote approval, legal release, and creative by next week.
Marco Jensen: I'll take customer sign-off and landing copy. Quick draft hero quote: "Redwood reduced our median latency and helped us ship personalized search faster." Sending to Aurora now.
Talia Reed: Creative can turn this into hero image + 3 social sizes + 2 clips (15s/45s). Will also make a gated one-pager. ETA: 48 hours after quote final.
LegalBot: Initiated legal review. Please attach benchmark methodology doc and test ID. Benchmarks should use phrasing like "approximately Xx" or "approximately X%". Also request signed release per marketing template and redaction of any PII.
Marco Jensen: Customer reply: approves quote with edits. They prefer "helped us deliver personalized search features faster". Approved quote now: "Redwood reduced our median latency and helped us deliver personalized search features faster." They also attached a signed release and a Loom recap.
Lena Ortiz: Great. Marco, can you paste the Loom link here? Need it for Ops handoff.
Marco Jensen: Loom: https://loom.com/share/aurora-clip-12345 — short recap from the CTO confirming numbers.
LegalBot: Verified release uploaded to legal repo. Also flagged benchmark numbers; please ensure marketing copy includes citation to test ID AUR-2026-11 and uses "approximately" phrasing for percent improvements.
Talia Reed: Noted. Will avoid absolutes in visuals. Also planning two headline variants for A/B test on the landing page. Can someone own the experiment settings?
OpsKay: I can wire the A/B split in HubSpot. Recommend 50/50, track conversion to gated one-pager and webinar sign-ups. Also will tag inbound leads with "aurora-case-2026" and route to AE queue.
Lena Ortiz: Engineering says approx 2.4x median latency improvement at 1.8k tokens and ~33% lower cost per token. Marketing phrasing: "approximately 2.4x median latency improvement" and "approximately 33% lower cost per token." Cite AUR-2026-11.
Marco Jensen: Pasted the landing draft here for customer preview: https://redwood.in/internal-drafts/aurora-case-2026. Customer preview requested for Mon 10/12.
Talia Reed: Will produce hero + social cards + 15s/45s clips and export captions. Also will include localized headlines for EN/JP since customer asked for a Japanese promo. Need translation help.
OpsKay: I can request translation through our vendor and wire the translated copy into the A/B test. Also creating HubSpot form with UTMs and webinar interest checkbox.
LegalBot: Final legal note: redact any specific customer PII in the transcript and include the signed release link in the internal launch doc. Legal approves publish after embargo and customer preview.
Lena Ortiz: Embargo set to Tue 10/13 09:00 PT per customer. Final checklist: Marco -> customer preview + landing copy; Talia -> creative exports + JP headline; OpsKay -> HubSpot routing + A/B test; LegalBot -> release (done). Reconvene here with final links. :rocket:
